# Aorila AI API

Base: https://api.aorila.com
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Compatible with the OpenAI chat schema.

## Hosts

| Host | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| https://api.aorila.com | AI API (this product) |
| https://aorila.com | Marketing |
| https://aorilalabs.com | Labs |

Do not send GPU/pod create calls to api.aorila.com.

## Models

- atraly-v1
- atraly-v1.5
- atraly-v2.0

List live IDs: GET https://api.aorila.com/v1/models

## Endpoints

GET /health
GET /v1/models
POST /v1/chat/completions

## Chat

```
curl https://api.aorila.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AORILA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "atraly-v2.0",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]
  }'
```

OpenAI SDK:

```
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.aorila.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["AORILA_API_KEY"])
client.chat.completions.create(model="atraly-v2.0", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}])
```

Config for operators (environment, not a database):

- AORILA_API_KEY — customer key
- AORILA_UPSTREAM_URL — inference backend
- AORILA_MODEL_MAP — public SKU → weights

Keys never go in git or Supabase.
